description: Create source-aware artwork credits, figure captions, and citations in Chicago, MLA, and APA. Import supported artwork records from The Met and the Cleveland Museum of Art, or provide metadata manually. STILL preserves museum credit lines, source URLs, licensing information, provenance, warnings, and exact UTC observation times. Available in English and Ukrainian. Generated credits do not grant permission to use an image and are not legal clearance.
